expected_rate: once per ISO week on its first trading day at 06:00 PT (Monday, or Tuesday after a Monday holiday or a failed Monday send)
window_reason: the report runs on the first trading day of the week; two sessions from a Sunday ship always include that Monday and the Tuesday fallback
reversal: the weekly GEX report is sent twice in one ISO week, is still sent on Saturday, or is not sent by Tuesday 06:00 PT in a week with a Monday or Tuesday session
baseline_exempt_reason: the weekly-marker line is new in this diff (the ISO-week marker did not exist before), so no earlier run can match it
